title: MetroAI Assistant (Gemini API) Update
message: Added the built-in MetroAI Assistant powered by the Gemini API (gemini-3.8-flash & gemini-3.5-flash-lite): one-tap Xray log diagnostics, Speed Test bufferbloat/throughput insights, smart server & settings advisor with one-tap Apply Settings / Switch Server actions, encrypted AndroidKeyStore bring-your-own API key storage, and strict privacy redaction.
